integrity: The reaching-threshold proof is symbolic; the included finite BFS checker is corroborative only. Independent audit and independent validation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only size-(n-2) targets in the canonical Cerny automaton are classified; the finite checker covers n=3..10, while the universal statement is proved symbolically. Absolute novelty cannot be certified against unindexed or unpublished sources.
title: Exact reaching threshold for size-\(n-2\) subsets of the Černý automaton
